messages:
ingrid (auditor): Hi team, auditor request: need evidence for inference-routing service. Deliverables: RBAC change record, MFA enforcement proof for service owners, KMS key usage logs for the service principal (last 30 days), a 2-line vuln triage summary, and the emergency KMS access runbook link. Deadline Tue 08:00 PST. Mark sensitive files.
meera (sec-eng): Got it. Prod + staging? Also do you want raw CloudTrail JSON or a CSV extract?
sam (infra): Prod+staging. I'll provide a CSV extract for 2024-11-01..2024-11-30. Key alias: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:alias/rw-infer-router.
liz (devops): RBAC change was in PR #5011 (role: rw-infer-runner). Approved 2024-11-07 by @meera. Role scoped to kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, s3:GetObject model-bucket/* and ecs:RunTask. No iam:Create* or kms:CreateKey. I'll include the PR diff and approver comments.
meera (sec-eng): MFA: service owners live in IdP group 'sec-service-owners'. Conditional Access policy CA-MFA-High enforced 2024-08-15. I'll attach policy ID and a screenshot with timestamp.
jordan (oncall): Splunk query I used: index=prod_kms source=cloudtrail arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:alias/rw-infer-router (Decrypt OR GenerateDataKey) | table _time,user,eventName,src_ip | head 500. I can redact IPs for public bundle.
sam (infra): Sample Decrypt (short): 2024-11-12T14:03:22Z Decrypt user=arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/rw-infer-runner/service-account keyId=alias/rw-infer-router.
sam (infra): Rotation event example: 2024-11-01T02:00:00Z RotateKey user=arn:aws:iam::123:role/kms-rotation-operator keyId=alias/rw-infer-router; rotation manifest posted to s3://redwood-audit/kms-rotations/2024-11/.
liz (devops): Least-privilege note: role policy diff in PR 5011 shows only the listed actions; explicit denies block iam:PassRole to avoid privilege escalation.
meera (sec-eng): Vulnerability triage (last 30d): one medium - outdated base image (CVE-2024-ABCD). Fix merged 2024-11-19, verified in staging and prod. No open high/critical items for this service.
jordan (oncall): FYI security-bot raised a KMS canary alert 2024-11-20T03:12Z; root cause: infra canary key test. Noted in canary runbook. I'll include the incident note.
sam (infra): Golden copy location: s3://redwood-audit/golden/kms/ (governed bucket) with 7-year retention and object lock. Export we send is a timeboxed 30-day slice.
meera (sec-eng): We'll mark KMS logs and unredacted ARNs/IPs as restricted. Public bundle will have redacted IPs and truncated ARNs; full set delivered via secure SFTP: sftp://auditor-upload.redwood/5991112223-infer-router-evidence (credentials OOB). Bundle README will map items to SOC2 CC6.1 and ISO A.9.2.2.
ingrid (auditor): Please upload by Mon 07:00 PST so we can ingest before review. Confirm when uploaded.
meera (sec-eng): Upload scheduled; will post link when complete.
security-bot: Incident bot: no active incidents tied to inference-routing in the last 90 days.
ingrid (auditor): Thanks everyone, that should cover it. Closing this thread once we have the control mapping attached. :thumbsup:
